relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: Using a preclinical model of intratibial inoculation of mouse 4T1 breast cancer cells, we found that the activation of the SN nociceptor TRPV1 induces CABP and stimulates 4T1 breast cancer progression in bone and metastasis to lung.

relationships.subject: SB366791
relationships.evidence_quote: Importantly, a single injection of a selective synthetic TRPV1 antagonist, SB366791, reduced SN excitation and CABP in these mice.

relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 is a nonselective cation channel highly permeable to Ca2+ and activated by capsaicin, acid (<pH 6.0), and noxious heat (greater than43 °C) and pro-inflammatory mediators such as prostaglandins, bradykinin, ATP, and 5-hydroxytryptamine, and nerve growth factor (NGF).

key_findings: TRPV1 activation on bone-innervating sensory nerves induces cancer bone pain and promotes breast cancer progression; TRPV1 antagonists reduce progression and lung metastasis.
